purpose: Cerrar rapidamente la candidata acumulativa e incremental después de la auditoría forense, con visualización en Preview después de cada bloque y sin reabrir trabajo ya aprobado salvo regresión demostrada.
executionRule: FIX_DIRECTLY_WHEN_CAUSE_IS_CLEAR; DO_NOT_SPEND_TIME_REDISCOVERING_AN_OLD_ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION_UNLESS NEEDED TO PRESERVE A BUSINESS RULE.
visualizationRule: EVERY_BLOCK_BUILDS_ONE_PREVIEW_FROM_CURRENT_ACCUMULATIVE_HEAD; PAULA_VISUALIZES_AND_ACCEPTS_OR_REPORTS_FINDINGS BEFORE NEXT_BLOCK; SAME_BLOCK_FINDINGS_ARE_FIXED_IN_PLACE, NOT MOVED TO A NEW PLAN.

policyCreationOrImport: Creating or importing a policy creates/updates the policy, its expected receipts according to payment frequency and the corresponding premium portfolio state.
Creating/importing a policy does NOT by itself prove a payment and therefore must not create a confirmed payment/cobro event.
renewal: A renewal creates a new renewal policy/version according to the approved renewal workflow and generates the new expected receipts and premium portfolio according to its payment terms.
Only when a payment is applied/confirmed or real payment evidence is reconciled is the corresponding confirmed cobro/payment materialized.
paymentEvidence: Real evidence may come from a policy/insurer invoice, bank statement, commission statement/planilla, uploaded payment support, or explicit manual confirmation.
Inference is allowed to MATCH real evidence to policy/receipt/client; inference may never invent that a payment occurred merely because a receipt is due or exists.
Manual/explicit reconciliation remains available from Cliente 360 and Cobros.
paymentApplicationSurfaces: Cliente 360 > Recibos y pagos must allow apply/confirm payment with payment date and optional invoice/evidence.
Cobros y cartera list/detail must allow the same canonical payment action.
Both surfaces call the same server-owned payment/reconciliation command and produce the same audit/readback result.
rolesAndFlows: Comercial and Asesor see and manage only their own authorized leads/gestiones and related customer/policy scope.
Operativo, Admin and Dirección can create/manage Ops items according to their configured scope.
A gestion can originate from Cliente 360, Client Portal, Leads, or Ops and must become one canonical gestion visible in every authorized projection.
Ops and Leads are projections of the same canonical process, not parallel records.
selfAdministration: Users, roles, countries, scopes, module permissions, tenant branding, insurers, clients, policies, vehicles, receipts/payment methods and allowed catalogs must be administrable from product UI where already approved.
No person identity or tenant-specific business value may be hardcoded when it belongs to tenant data/configuration.

The current objective is production-safe self-administration of approved capabilities; future generic SaaS/no-code expansion remains incremental after production and must reuse these same authorities.

antiRegressionRules: No new top-level methodology, repo, branch, Firebase project, importer or parallel persistence owner.
Do not reconstruct approved modules; fix current accumulated candidate directly when the business rule is known.
Every code change is additive/incremental from the current accumulated candidate; never replace it with an older module package.
Before editing a module, identify the current effective runtime owner; after editing, prove that no older owner still overrides it.
A module cannot be declared PASS because a button exists; PASS requires authenticated UI action, server commit when applicable, canonical readback, visual refresh and audit.
No silent optimistic success for production-critical writes.
No destructive reimport to fix UI, routing, permissions, caching or hierarchy.
No policy/renewal/import may synthesize a confirmed payment without real payment evidence.
Evidence-based inference may match a real payment artifact; it may not infer payment from obligation existence.
Every block must expose a Preview for immediate visual review before the next block starts.
Findings discovered inside a block are fixed inside that block unless they require a genuinely new business decision.
If a business rule is unclear, execution stops only for that rule and asks Paula; unaffected work continues.
All decisions in this lock and addendum are repository authority and do not depend on conversation memory.
No hardcoded people. No hardcoded tenant business configuration where UI/configuration is the approved owner.
Final LIVE promotion must use the same immutable artifact visually accepted in Preview.
stopConditions: need to alter a previously approved business rule rather than implement it
authority mismatch that would risk writing to a parallel namespace
onlyOpenBusinessQuestion: When real payment evidence has one unique high-confidence inferred match, should the system auto-commit the reconciliation/payment, or create a proposed match that requires one human confirmation click?
